author: Ari Koslow
title: German Marquez to start Tuesday for Padres
desc: German Marquez will start for the Padres on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Marquez threw 56 pitches over three innings in his first game back from the All-Star break last week. He'll remain off the fantasy radar as he likely remains on a pitch count.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval expected to start Thursday
desc: Patrick Sandoval is expected to make his season debut for the Red Sox on Thursday against the White Sox.
impact: Sandoval was activated from the 60-day injured list on Monday. He'll likely be a player to wait-and-see on for fantasy managers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Buehler struggles again Monday
desc: Walker Buehler allowed seven runs on seven hits over five innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a loss on Monday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Buehler allowed a pair of home runs, including a three-run shot to Max Kepler. He has allowed 16 runs over two starts to begin July. He'll look to close the first half strong against the Blue Jays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Kepler drives in four runs Monday
desc: Max Kepler went 2-for-4 with a home run and four RBI in the Diamondbacks 8-0 win over the Padres on Monday.
impact: Kepler opened the scoring with an RBI single in the opening frame. He later added a three-run long ball. He'll continue to play in his platoon role moving forward.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan Arenado goes deep Monday
desc: Nolan Arenado went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 8-0 win on Monday against the Padres.
impact: Arenado extended the Diamondbacks lead to 8-0 with a solo shot to open the sixth inning. He is now hitting .240 on the season with 10 deep balls.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt earns win Monday
desc: Brandon Pfaadt allowed four hits over five scoreless innings with six strikeouts in a win on Monday against the Padres.
impact: Pfaadt has given Arizona two solid starts since being called back up to the majors. He is scheduled for one more start before the All-Star break against the Dodgers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braydon Fisher placed on bereavement list
desc: The Blue Jays placed RHP Braydon Fisher on the bereavement list.
impact: Fisher will be away for a few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Springer activated from family medical emergency list
desc: The Blue Jays activated OF/DH George Springer from the family medical emergency list.
impact: Springer should be back in the lineup on Tuesday. He is slashing .221/.308/.373 with eight home runs through 279 plate appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer (back) to make rehab start Wednesday
desc: Max Scherzer is scheduled to make his next rehab start on Wednesday for Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Scherzer threw 49 pitches during a rehab outing for High-A Vancouver last Friday. He should be activated after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cameron Weston optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles optioned RHP Cameron Weston to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Weston did not make an appearance since being called up.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Laweryson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Twins optioned RHP Cody Laweryson to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Lawyerson will continue to move up and down throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kade Morris optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned RHP Kade Morris to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Morris should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Kelly released by Athletics
desc: The Athletics released RHP Michael Kelly.
impact: Kelly passed through waivers unclaimed. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) to throw live BP Saturday
desc: Blake Snell will face hitters on Saturday in a live batting practice session.
impact: Snell is continuing to work his way back from an innovative NanoScope procedure to remove loose bodies from his elbow back in late May. If all goes well on Saturday, he should be nearing a rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Hamilton suffers hamstring injury Monday
desc: David Hamilton was removed from Monday's game against the Cardinals with left hamstring tightness.
impact: Hamilton will head to be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status on Tuesday.
